title: ctxloom run --print --json result
description: Published contract for the JSON emitted by `ctxloom run --print --json`, produced by operations.RunOneshotResult. This is the canonical per-agent run shape that map/weave nest.

profile.description: Profile the run was assembled from. Omitted when no profile was used.

output.description: Captured stdout of the one-shot agent run.

label.description: Display label for the run (profile name or a synthesized label).

backend.description: Backend type that executed the run (e.g. claude, gemini, mock).

model.description: Resolved model id. Omitted when the backend reports none.

exit_code.description: Process exit code of the agent run; 0 on success.
